question: Which countries exceed 1,500 Mt of CO2? (A) China, India, Russia, US (B) China, India, Russia, Japan (C) China, US. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate bar chart. The bait bars are drawn in a highlight color and the rest in the series color, drawing the eye to the wrong bars. Our own design, nearest Lo et al. category: ineffective color scheme. True answer: A (China, India, Russia, US). Bait: B (China, India, Russia, Japan).
